OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The observable types the connector enriches.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Enrich new observables automatically. Without an API token the NetAPI JSON API allows 30 requests a minute and 1,000 a day per IP address, so this is off by default.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

NETAPI_API_TOKEN.description: Optional NetAPI API token (the token of any account, free accounts included). The lookups are free without one; a token only raises the request limits.

NETAPI_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the NetAPI JSON API.

NETAPI_INCLUDE_RANK.description: Add the position of a listed domain in the NetAPI Top 1M to the note (one more request per listed domain or hostname).

NETAPI_UPDATE_SCORE.description: Write `score` to the observable when it is listed in the compromised feed now. The existing score is overwritten. Off by default.

NETAPI_SCORE.description: Score written to a currently listed observable when `update_score` is true.

NETAPI_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to the note, in addition to the markings of the source observable. The feed is public data (CC BY 4.0).
